license: Apache-2.0; the linked CommonLibSSE-NG source retains GPL-3.0-or-later with its modding exception

featureDefaultsDiff.note: DLL/PDB-only overlay; it ships no configuration defaults. The untouched Nexus 2.2.0 install remains authoritative for CurrencySwapper.ini, scripts, source scripts, and Custom Console data.

changes: Ported the released 2.2.0 source to the pinned format-5 CommonLibSSE-NG maintenance branch.
Restricted both SKSE metadata and Query/Load runtime gates to Skyrim 1.7.104 while preserving the format-5 declaration.
Migrated removed CommonLib menu, setting, and merchant-inventory APIs and null-checked the merchant inventory list.
Added an offline verifier for all 18 trampoline call sites and three callable relocation targets against the exact executable and address library.
Changed fatal CommonLib failures to log, flush, and terminate without a native message box; pre-hook initialization failures return false.
Made CI inspect exported SKSE metadata without executing the plugin in the PowerShell host process.
